tasks.title: Set the Table
tasks.instruction: Take the plate, bowl, fork, and knife out of the crate. Place the plate face up in the lower center of the placemat and the bowl open side up in the upper center, in front of the plate. Place the fork on the left and the knife on the right, with the fork tines and knife tip pointing toward the front. Complete these actions in any order.

tasks.procedure: Take the plate, bowl, fork, and knife from the tableware container. Place the plate on the tablecloth, the bowl in front of the plate, the fork to the left of the plate, and the knife to the right of the plate.
